rootCause.summary: Many formats share the same JsonInvoiceLayoutRenderer block pipeline. Uniqueness was previously faked via optional-block injection / theme swaps, or entire families (HAWB extras, HBL Format-23+) cloned one shell. Catalogue PDF path is generateInvoiceFormatPreviewPdf → InvoiceFormatLayoutByKind → JsonInvoiceLayoutRenderer.
